subject: Request for provisional attestation (bridge) and renewal gating items
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@brightbridgehealth.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@brightbridgehealth.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + provisional attestation needed for upcoming renewal

Hi Diego / Monica,

We’re kicking off BrightBridge’s renewal evaluation and I ran into a procurement gating item: we need your latest SOC 2 Type II report and — if the audit coverage doesn’t align with our renewal date (Nov 15, 2026) — a provisional attestation or bridge letter that explicitly covers the gap.

Quick background: our legal and procurement team requires either a current Type II report that includes the 12 months up to at least Aug 31, 2026, or a bridge/provisional attestation that states when the next Type II will be completed and certifies controls continuity in the intervening period.

Can you confirm:
- What period your latest Type II covers (dates)?
- Whether you can provide a bridge/provisional attestation and the exact coverage dates it would state?
- Estimated delivery timeline for the bridge letter and any supporting artifacts (control matrix excerpt, SOC summary)?

Procurement is aiming to issue PO by 2026-09-15; we’ll need the letter and evidence before contract signature if possible. I’ve attached our procurement checklist for reference (BBH_procurement_checklist.xlsx).

Thanks — can we aim for a short call if there’s any ambiguity about scope?

Sara Patel
Senior Sourcing Manager
BrightBridge Health

Attachment: BBH_procurement_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: SOC 2 Type II + provisional attestation needed for upcoming renewal

Sara — thanks for the clear note and checklist. Looping Monica (Customer Success) and Neha (Security/Compliance) to scope and deliverables.

Short answers up front:
- Our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers the control period 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31 (report issued Mar 2026).
- We do offer a bridge/provisional attestation for audit-window gaps. We can prepare a bridge letter that:
  • States the dates covered by the last Type II (above),
  • Affirms that controls remained in place and there were no material control changes in the subsequent period, and
  • Notes the target date for delivery of the next Type II (we expect the next Type II to complete in Q3 2026 with a final report available by mid-September 2026).

Next steps I propose:
1) Security drafts the bridge letter (Neha, see suggested templates attached).
2) We provide the SOC 2 summary PDF and a small redacted control-matrix excerpt for procurement.
3) We confirm exact coverage dates in the final letter and deliver via DocuSign for signature.

Prelim timeline (subject to legal review):
- Draft bridge letter shared internally by 2026-08-31
- Draft delivered to BrightBridge for review by 2026-09-02
- Finalized and DocuSigned by 2026-09-07 (target)

If PO timeline (2026-09-15) holds, we should be aligned. Please confirm whether the bridge letter needs to reference specific subcontractors or an SOC 2 scoping clause — if so, call that out.

I’ve attached our SOC summary and a bridge-template for reference.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_type2_2025_summary.pdf (PDF, 128KB); bridge_letter_draft.docx (Word, 34KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@brightbridgehealth.com>, diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: SOC 2 Type II + provisional attestation needed for upcoming renewal

Hi Sara — thanks for reaching out and for the checklist. I’m driving the compliance artifacts for this request. A few clarifications and what we can provide: 

1) Scope & language: our bridge letter will be a provisional attestation referencing the last Type II (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31), stating that control environments remained consistent and no material exceptions were identified post-report. It will also include an estimated date for the next Type II completion (we expect final report delivery around 2026-09-14). The letter will be limited in scope to the systems/services in your contract.

2) Subcontractors: we will explicitly list any major third-party subprocessors that are in-scope for BrightBridge’s services. If you need the letter to assert coverage for all subprocessors, please confirm the names; otherwise we’ll reference subprocessors per our standard scope clause.

3) Supporting artifacts: we can provide a redacted control-matrix excerpt and the SOC 2 summary PDF. SIG/CAIQ/complete control lists require an NDA in some cases; if you need a full SIG, let us know and we’ll route the NDA/secure-drive access. Attached is a short control excerpt that typically satisfies procurement checks.

4) Timeline & approvals: I’ll prepare an internal draft by 2026-08-31. Diego / Legal to review; once approved we’ll send to your procurement/legal for sign-off. If BrightBridge wants DocuSign, include the signer email and signer name and we’ll generate the envelope.

Attachment: control_matrix_excerpt.csv (CSV, 18KB)

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the language.

—Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Request: SOC 2 Type II + provisional attestation needed for upcoming renewal

Diego / Neha — this is great, thank you. A couple of final asks so procurement/legal can close their checklist: 

1) Please ensure the bridge letter explicitly states the coverage window (e.g., "Type II report covers 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31; bridge attests continuous controls from 2026-01-01 through 2026-09-14 until the next Type II report").
2) Call out any subcontractors in-scope for BrightBridge (we can follow up with a short list; include them in the final letter if possible).
3) Can you send the DocuSign link for signature once the final is ready? Our legal lead (Priya Raj, priya.raj@brightbridgehealth.com) should be included as the signer for the attestation.

We will issue the PO by 2026-09-15 as planned. If you can meet the 2026-09-07 DocuSign target Diego mentioned, procurement will proceed to signature shortly after.

Appreciate the responsiveness — looping Priya in on copy.

Thanks,
Sara
Senior Sourcing Manager
BrightBridge Health

Cc: Priya Raj <priya.raj@brightbridgehealth.com>
